question: **Directions: Choose the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'Dialogue.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the options:-

 
 
• '**Diloge**': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
 
• 'Dialogue': The correctly spelt word is 'Dialogue' and it means** a discussion between people who have different opinions**. (अलग-अलग विचारों वाले लोगों के बीच वार्तालाप या विचार-विमर्श)
 
• '**Dieloge**': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
 
• '**Dilogue**': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
